items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: So this was the first Dry Jack thing... Dry Jack was one of the — for some reason I guess ‘cause we were local... Rod and I were invited out to play with him.

ctx.x: Would you mind holding up, I think those LPs are right there.
Oh yeah. So this was the first Dry Jack thing, “Magical Elements” and then “Whale City.” © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
